recommendations.text: Implantable cardioverter defibrillator use is recommended to reduce sudden cardiac death in patients with symptomatic HF (NYHA Class II–III) and LVEF ≤35% despite optimal medical therapy for >3 months and at least 6 weeks after MI who are expected to survive for at least 1 year with good functional status.
Intravenous beta-blocker and/or amiodarone treatment is recommended for patients with polymorphic VT and/or VF unless contraindicated.
